subject.title: [Bug] Feishu: message(action=send) renders card JSON as plain text instead of interactive card (regression)

question: Should the next Feishu plain-message card JSON fix require live Feishu proof before adoption, or may maintainers accept source and focused test proof for a narrow plugin-local parser?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but multiple direct fix PRs closed unmerged after proof/review gating, so automation should pause until the Feishu proof bar or adoption path is explicit.

options.title: Require live Feishu proof first
options.body: Keep this issue open and wait for a candidate branch or maintainer run that shows `message(action=send)` rendering the supplied card in a real Feishu chat.

options.title: Accept source and test proof
options.body: Sponsor a narrow Feishu parser fix with focused channel/outbound tests and treat live Feishu validation as desirable but not mandatory.

options.title: Retire raw JSON auto-detection
options.body: Document that plain `message` card JSON is no longer supported and direct users to structured `presentation` or `channelData.feishu.card` sends instead.

recommendation.title: Require live Feishu proof first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and wait for a candidate branch or maintainer run that shows `message(action=send)` rendering the supplied card in a real Feishu chat.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the documented Feishu plugin contact and best available owner for the Feishu-specific support and proof boundary.
